newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Luxembourg electric company eyes telecoms.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg electric company eyes telecoms.

text.p: Luxembourg's partially private state electricity firm Compagnie Grand-Ducale d'Electricite du Luxembourg (Cegedel) is eyeing a move into telecommunications.

In a notice calling shareholders to an extraordinary general meeting on March 17, Cegedel said it wants to add to the definition in its statutes of its principal activity as delivering energy the clause "as well as in the area of communications and in the delivery of services in general."
Cegedel chief executive officer Alfred Giuliani was not immediately available to comment or give details.
Cegedel has been one of the fastest rising stocks in Luxembourg in the past year with its share price more than doubling to 27,100 Luxembourg francs.
